metadata.description: Jody's portable pro dev skill stack

plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Universal base skills and guardrails: find-skills, using-pro-dev (the cross-lifecycle router that maps a task to the right phase and skill, including bridge skills like impeccable-bridge, qa-suite, and lavish), and dream (memory consolidation over Claude Code auto-memory: scans session transcripts for corrections, decisions, preferences, and patterns, merges the findings into the memory files, and rebuilds a lean MEMORY.md index under 200 lines). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). /dream runs a consolidation on demand, with dry-run and status modes. PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch. A Stop hook flags when a 24h memory consolidation is due, per project, and a SessionStart hook nudges the next session to run /dream. A UserPromptSubmit hook recalls the memories relevant to each prompt, ranking the project's memory notes with BM25 and injecting nothing when nothing clears the score floor. A second Stop hook keeps a dated session ledger under the memory directory so consolidation knows which transcripts to read. /pro-dev-doctor health-checks an installed marketplace (plugin coverage, strict validation, routing smoke check).

plugins.name: pro-execution
plugins.description: Execution discipline skills: TDD, systematic debugging, git worktrees, Worktrunk parallel worktree management (/wt), and subagent-driven development. Depends on pro-core for universal guardrails and repo safety. worktrunk is an optional companion, not a hard dependency - install it with templates/install-companions.sh or `brew install worktrunk`.

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion, user-validation. A Stop hook detects when a session ends with real changes and hands the user a validation checklist (what changed, what was verified, what needs their eyes) written to .pro-dev/validation/latest.md; /validate produces one on demand. Ships three documentation subagents (technical-writer, documentation-engineer, api-documenter) with /document and /api-docs, adapted from VoltAgent/awesome-codex-subagents. Enforces doc freshness before git push (the block routes into /document), nudges api-documenter when an OpenAPI/GraphQL/proto contract changes, and blocks plan saves outside the project directory.

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js skills: next-best-practices (auto-applied guardrails for file conventions, RSC boundaries, async APIs, data patterns, error handling, metadata, image/font), next-upgrade (structured upgrade workflow with codemods), next-cache-components (PPR, use cache, cacheLife, cacheTag), shadcn (component installation, theming, composition patterns). Adapted from vercel-labs/next-skills. Also installs vercel and figma from claude-plugins-official via install-companions.sh.

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills. Build: emil-design-eng (start here for components and screens), landing-page-design (single-CTA conversion landing page with a visual system), build-awwwards-quality-sites (immersive scroll-storytelling marketing sites), apple-design (Apple HIG principles). Motion: animate (add or refine animation on an already built site), animation-vocabulary (turn vague motion words into exact animation terms), motion (Framer Motion implementation + discipline), motion-system. Review and fix: screen-critique with the /critique-screen command (judge a rendered screen against seven critique lenses), interface-review (review UI changes in a PR, branch, or working tree with regression detection), better-interface (the holistic consolidation and verdict layer over the better-* family; uninstalled domains report as Not reviewed), better-layout (spacing, alignment, and grouping to the pixel), perception-laws (Gestalt laws, Von Restorff, visual hierarchy), accessibility-audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR). Systems: design tokens, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition, stitch-skill (create/update DESIGN.MD), taste-skill (targeted visual polish pass). Bridges (not vendored): impeccable-bridge for the full end-to-end UI/UX pass via /design-engine, taste-skills-bridge for the Leonxlnx anti-slop, visual-style, image-gen, and brand-kit library via /taste-skills, plus web-design-engineer-bridge (reference-grounded HTML artifacts, style recipes, design scoring), tastemaker-bridge (extract tokens from a reference image's real pixels and lock the style across a project), and mengto-skills-bridge (scroll storytelling, WebGL and shader effects, video-to-superprompt) - all three installed with the /design-skills command. Install figma from claude-plugins-official via install-companions.sh.

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: The Verify phase: native Vitest (unit/component), agent-browser (interactive verification), and Storybook interactions, plus qa-suite — a bridge to the petrkindlmann/qa-skills library installed on demand via the /qa-engine command (npx skills add): qa-do/qa-start routers, playwright-automation, visual-testing, api/contract-testing, test-reliability, and QA strategy/risk/planning. Playwright is provided on demand via the qa-suite bridge (/qa-engine), not as a hard plugin dependency.

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth skills: Drizzle ORM (architecture + schema), Prisma schema patterns, NextAuth/Auth.js patterns

plugins.name: pro-spdd
plugins.description: Structured Prompt-Driven Development workflow: story decomposition, analysis, REASONS Canvas, generation, prompt update, sync, API test, code review, and reverse engineering. Includes openspdd-ts CLI (bin/openspdd.mjs) for installing templates into any AI editor. Depends on pro-execution for disciplined implementation workflows. Adapted from gszhangwei/open-spdd.

plugins.name: pro-pdd
plugins.description: Default Define + Plan skills: interview-me and idea-refine (Define-phase intent extraction and idea refinement, forked from addyosmani/agent-skills), brainstorming, written implementation plans, adhd — parallel divergent ideation under cognitive frames via /adhd (forked from UditAkhourii/adhd), and lavish — a bridge plus /lavish command for the kunchenguid/lavish-axi CLI that renders agent output (plans, tables, diagrams, diffs, reports) as reviewable HTML artifacts the user annotates in the browser (installed on demand via /lavish-engine). Depends on pro-execution for worktree and subagent execution handoff.

plugins.name: pro-gstack
plugins.description: Opt-in GStack workflow adapters: persona-driven planning, review, QA, shipping, browser, security, documentation, and memory workflows. Adapted from garrytan/gstack.

plugins.name: pro-research
plugins.description: Deep web research engine for any topic. /research <question> runs an adaptive intake interview, then decomposes into angles, fans out research subagents over a free-first retrieval ladder (Serper -> Jina/Firecrawl -> agent-browser), verifies citations, and synthesizes a cited report. /lead-research <company|domain|ICP> is the lead/account specialization: same engine plus ICP scoring and cited lead profiles. Domain memory + evidence persisted to .research/ to survive compaction. Mieruka integration: drives the Research tab via MCP tools (list_research_threads, get_research_thread, update_research_thread) when .mieruka/ is present; falls back to file-mirror.

plugins.name: pro-motion
plugins.description: Motion and video skills: remotion (React-based programmatic video rendering), hyperframes (advanced Framer Motion orchestration), and gsap (GSAP timeline + ScrollTrigger animations for marketing and hero surfaces).

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs Jody's default pro dev stack (core, pdd, execution, quality, design, motion, testing, data, nextjs, and research). worktrunk is an optional companion installed via install-companions.sh, not a dependency.
